:::{#exm-sigma-algebra-closed-under}
#### A $\sigma$-algebra is closed under complements and countable unions

A [$\sigma$-algebra](#def-sigma-algebra) $\salg$ on a set $S$
is [closed under](functions.qmd#def-closed-under) complements in $S$
and under unions of sequences of its sets,
because @def-sigma-algebra requires both.
The collection in @exm-not-sigma-algebra is not closed under complements.

:::
